title: You Think Your Stomach Drives Hunger, Yet a Rigged Wall Clock Doubled Snacking
description:
You think an empty stomach tells you when to eat! Yet a secretly rigged wall clock doubled college snacking! This is the true story of the Columbia rigged clock experiment. Here is what went wrong with pure stomach hunger theories.
